plugins.name: gh-review-loop
plugins.description: Clears AI reviewer feedback on your PR: reads real review-thread state, sweeps the sibling instances the reviewer missed, gates every push on your repo's own tests, then requests re-review — hard-capped so it can never spam the PR. Works with Codex out of the box, or any reviewer bot you configure.
